target_facts.statement: At a stop sign, halt completely and wait for crossing traffic and the crosswalk to clear. Use an available stop line; if needed, advance afterward to the sign or intersection edge, then proceed when safe. At a yield sign, reduce speed and give priority to traffic in the intersection or road you are entering.
